speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the neonatal unit. I am Dr. Agent. You presented with seizures and lethargy three days after birth; have you noticed any fever, poor feeding, or bulging fontanelle since delivery?

speaker: Patient
text: 1100-g (2-lb 7-oz) newborn, 31 weeks' gestation. The patient was born three days ago with a birth weight of 1100 g at 31 weeks' gestation. The antenatal period was complicated by chorioamnionitis. Apgar scores were 3 and 6 at 1 and 5 minutes, respectively. The patient has become increasingly lethargic over the past 18 hours and experienced a tonic seizure lasting for 25 seconds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Sepsis with Meningitis.

I have noted the history of chorioamnionitis, low birth weight, low Apgar scores, and the specific seizure duration. Given the signs of infection and neurological compromise, I am requesting an urgent Gram stain and culture of the CSF, blood, and urine to confirm the causative organism.
